farms.name: Hofstraat
farms.history: Founded 2000. Wim Smit started as a hobby after the Y2K/millennium moment prompted him and wife Karin to finally pursue winemaking; first wine 'Mikeljac Shiraz,' made in a garage on the original Hofstraat street.
farms.people: Wim Smit (proprietor/winemaker); Karin Smit (co-owner; also runs the Cherry Lane eatery)

farms.name: Nativo
farms.history: Founded 2000. Billy Hughes (Argentinian-born) and his late wife Penny Hughes bought 'an old wheat farm' near Malmesbury, Swartland. Public tasting: farm-visit tastings every alternate Saturday, max 10 people, R200/person deposit.
farms.people: Billy Hughes (founder), Penny Hughes (co-founder, deceased 2014), Kiki Hughes (daughter, sales & marketing) — trades as 'Hughes Family Wines'.

farms.history: Paarl (Barebones Colombar, Barebones Cinsault, Barebones Pet Nat, Guided By The Moon) and only two are W.O. Swartland (Bloodline Pet Nat, The Flash Series).
